map.评估咽反射（gag reflex）的敏感度分级，辅助判断舌咽神经与迷走神经功能及: Grades the sensitivity of the gag reflex, helping to judge glossopharyngeal and vagus nerve function and its clinical significance.
map.咽反射分级 0 至 4：0 消失、1 减弱、2 正常、3 亢进、4 极度敏感；0: Gag reflex grading runs from 0 to 4: 0 absent, 1 diminished, 2 normal, 3 hyperactive, 4 extremely sensitive; 0 and 1 suggest glossopharyngeal or vagus nerve damage, while 3 and 4 suggest an upper motor neuron lesion (pseudobulbar palsy).
map.刺激咽后壁无反应: No response on stimulating the posterior pharyngeal wall
map.反射消失，提示舌咽神经/迷走神经损伤（球麻痹、延髓病变等）: Absent reflex, suggesting glossopharyngeal or vagus nerve damage (bulbar palsy, medullary lesions and similar)
map.反射减弱，可见于高龄、神经系统退行性病变或周围神经损伤: A diminished reflex, which can be seen in advanced age, neurodegenerative disease or peripheral nerve injury
map.刺激后有正常呕吐反射: A normal vomiting reflex after stimulation
map.正常咽反射，舌咽神经/迷走神经功能正常: Normal gag reflex with intact glossopharyngeal and vagus nerve function
map.轻微刺激即诱发强烈反射: Even slight stimulation provokes a strong reflex
map.反射亢进，提示上运动神经元病变（假性球麻痹等）: A hyperactive reflex, suggesting an upper motor neuron lesion (pseudobulbar palsy and similar)
map.反射亢进伴恶心呕吐: Hyperactive reflex with nausea and vomiting
map.极度敏感，影响口腔检查和治疗操作，可见于心理因素或神经官能症: Extremely sensitive, interfering with oral examination and treatment; seen with psychological factors or neurosis
map.嘱患者张口，用压舌板轻轻刺激咽后壁或舌腭弓: Ask the patient to open the mouth and gently stimulate the posterior pharyngeal wall or the palatoglossal arch with a tongue depressor
map.观察咽部肌肉收缩反应（软腭上抬、咽缩肌收缩）: Observe the pharyngeal muscle contraction (soft palate elevation, constrictor contraction)
map.双侧分别测试，比较两侧反应差异: Test each side separately and compare the two responses
map.记录反射强度及是否伴有恶心、呕吐: Record the reflex strength and whether nausea or vomiting accompanies it
map.检查前告知患者操作内容，取得配合: Explain the procedure to the patient beforehand to gain cooperation
map.刺激力度应适中，避免过度刺激导致呕吐: Use moderate stimulation and avoid overstimulating, which can provoke vomiting
map.部分正常人咽反射可不明显，需结合其他神经体征综合判断: The gag reflex can be inconspicuous in some healthy people, so judge it together with other neurological signs
map.咽反射消失不一定为病理性，部分人天生反射减弱: An absent gag reflex is not necessarily pathological, since some people are born with a weak reflex
map.咽反射的传入神经为舌咽神经（CN IX），传出神经为迷走神经（CN X）。反射弧: The afferent limb of the gag reflex is the glossopharyngeal nerve (CN IX) and the efferent limb is the vagus nerve (CN X), with the reflex centre in the medulla. Bilateral absence with tongue atrophy and fasciculation indicates bulbar palsy (true medullary palsy), while a hyperactive reflex with forced crying and laughing indicates pseudobulbar palsy.
map.吞咽困难患者评估咽反射与误吸风险。: Assessing the gag reflex and aspiration risk in patients with dysphagia.
map.卒中后球麻痹筛查。: Screening for bulbar palsy after stroke.
map.全麻/插管前气道评估。: Airway assessment before general anaesthesia or intubation.
map.压舌板刺激咽后壁无恶心反射，咽反射消失，结合饮水呛咳提示球麻痹，需吞咽造影与误吸: Stimulating the posterior pharyngeal wall with a tongue depressor produces no retching; the absent gag reflex together with choking on water suggests bulbar palsy, so a swallowing study and aspiration assessment are needed.
map.咽反射消失一定异常吗？: Is an absent gag reflex always abnormal?
map.部分健康人反射弱或无（尤其老年人），需结合吞咽功能；若突发消失伴呛咳应警惕神经损: Some healthy people have a weak or absent reflex, especially the elderly, so consider swallowing function too; a sudden absence with choking warrants suspicion of nerve damage.
map.传入为舌咽神经（IX），传出为迷走神经（X），双侧皮质延髓束支配，单侧受损可减弱: The afferent limb is the glossopharyngeal nerve (IX) and the efferent limb the vagus nerve (X), with bilateral corticobulbar supply, so unilateral damage can weaken the reflex.
